addr: 18th Cross Rd, next to Subramanya Swami matha, Sector 3, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: A delightful place with a wide variety of snacks, sweets, and savouries to choose from. The food is tasty and reasonably priced, making it a great value for money. The live counters serving chole bhatura, sandwiches, and parathas add a fresh and engaging touch to the experience.

I recently visited Sangam in HSR Layout to try out some of their popular street food items. I ordered Pav Bhaji, Dahi Chaat, and Vada Pav, and overall, the taste was really impressive. The Pav Bhaji was flavorful, buttery, and had that …

Chole bhature and rasamalai tastes excellent. Must try. I If you’re looking for authentic, handmade treats that taste like home, look no further. The balance of flavors is perfect—not too sugary, just pure deliciousness. It’s clear that a lot of love and tradition goes into everything they make.
